Bit 2 - 1'b1 indicates the write status bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 3 - 1'b1 indicates the read bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 4 - 1'b0 indicates the port follows the VBUS protocol else it is set to 1'b1. Bits 5-7 are set to 3'b000.
